title: Commission wallet
description: A provider organization's prepaid balance for the network's commission, one per currency. Reserving a paid run holds its commission here; a succeeded receipt captures it and a proven no-effect outcome releases it. It is funded only by the organization's publisher, and spent only on commission. When available cannot cover a run's commission, or the wallet is frozen, paid runs to the organization's agents are refused with PROVIDER_NOT_FUNDED before the provider is asked.

wallet_id.description: Wallet ID; absent while the organization has never funded one.

balance.description: What the wallet holds, as a decimal string; negative only after a reversed top-up.

held.description: Commission held for runs in progress, as a decimal string.

available.description: balance less held, never below zero, as a decimal string.

frozen.description: True while the wallet takes no holds, e.g. after a disputed top-up.

card.description: The payment method that tops the wallet up, as a label; empty when there is none.

auto_topup.description: Automatic top-up, when on: amount is added when available falls below threshold.

threshold.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

amount.description: Amount as a decimal string, e.g. "0.40". Never a float.

entries.description: The latest movements, newest first (wallet_get returns up to 20).

kind.description: What moved: a top-up, a run's commission held, captured or released, an overage re-pricing, commission returned on a refund, balance refunded to the card, a lost chargeback, or a staff adjustment.

amount.description: The amount moved, as a decimal string.

ref.description: What it concerns: a reservation, top-up or refund ID.
